title: Resonant Frequency
description: Essential Criteria: The correct value of omega for resonant transitions must be provided as omega = 2mu Bz / hbar.

title: Probability Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The probability expression for a proton having spin in the -z direction must be correctly stated as P = (mu B0 / (hbar Omega))^2 sin^2(Omega t).

title: Omega Approximation
description: Important Criteria: The approximation for Omega should be correctly derived as Omega approximately equals (1/hbar)(hbar omega/2 + mu Bz) under the condition Bz >> B0.

title: Hamiltonian Setup
description: Important Criteria: The Hamiltonian should be correctly set up, showing the contributions from the magnetic field components.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common errors such as sign mistakes in the Hamiltonian or incorrect factors in the probability expressions.
